# Selected-source CLI first observation

This is informed repository work under Issue #32's selected-source execution
plan. It is not a blind authoring experiment. The exact deployed model and
sampling settings are not recorded. Existing mixed-Boolean and parameter-pattern
sources and their observations remain unchanged in their original sessions.

Before changing the CLI, preserve this explicit Unit-parameter declaration.
Its ordinary result does not make it a closed invocation: a declared runtime
Unit argument is still an argument. The new Raw check may inspect that open
signature, but Raw run/sample must reject it before any native invocation.
No implicit argument is provided by a zero-width physical interface.

The baseline executable already contains the shared mixed Raw API. Its CLI
still selects the hierarchy for legacy sized commands, and ordinary selected
module-map commands are not yet implemented. Capture actual outcomes without
inferring native success or failure from a source or usage rejection.
